title: metadata designer: a report's or dataset's Label in a non-Latin script (or a cleared Label) derives the Name `field`, where the object designer leaves it empty and asks for one
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible authoring defect with a named landing point. **reach:** a public entry, the console's report and dataset designers in create mode, measured in Chromium against a live backend.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage. The landing is the Label handlers' Name derivation in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` and `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`) from the os-dev report on objectui#12746 (PR #12788), which leaves these lines unchanged. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens
- In create mode, a Label typed in a non-Latin script derives the Name `field`. Measured with the Label 收入.
- Clearing the Label also leaves the Name `field`.
- The object designer, measured the same way, derives an empty Name in both cases, so the author is asked for one.
- So a report or dataset authored with a Chinese (or any non-Latin) Label is silently named `field`. A second one would collide.

## Measured
- Backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, with a writable package `com.qa.vrf` (namespace `qavrf`).
- The console was objectui `claude/issue-12746-name-keeps-underscore` on Vite. For these Label handlers it is byte-identical to `main` `3e2c763`. Chromium, real keystrokes.
- On `/apps/crm_app/metadata/report/new?package=com.qa.vrf` and `.../dataset/new?package=com.qa.vrf`, the Label 收入 derives the Name `field`, and so does a cleared Label.
- Control: on `/apps/crm_app/metadata/object/new?package=com.qa.vrf`, the same Labels derive an empty Name.

## Mechanism (read from source on `main`)
- The report and dataset Label handlers derive with `toFieldName(v)`. When the result is empty, it falls back to the string `field`.
- `nameFollowsLabel` compares against the same function.
- `ObjectDefaultInspector` derives with `slugify`, which yields an empty string, so the Name stays empty and must be typed.

## Expected
A Label that yields no machine name leaves the report's or dataset's Name empty, as the object designer does, so the author is asked for one. No placeholder name is written silently.

**Dedupe** (open and closed):
- every objectui `domain:ui` card (2433 rows) plus the newest objectui issues, grepped for the `toFieldName` / `field` fallback, `non-Latin`, `CJK label` and a Name reading `field`: no match on this subject. The hits are objectui#6610, #5554, #10547, #6609, #6366 and #5120, all other subjects, and #12746, the card this came from;
- positive control on the same rows: `flow designer`, 24 hits.

Dedupe words: report dataset Name field non-Latin label, toFieldName field fallback label derivation, CJK label derives name field, label cleared name field.
